name: Five Card Stud High-Low
description: Five Card Stud with pot split between best high hand and best qualifying low hand.

overview.description: Five Card Stud with pot split between best high hand and best qualifying low hand.

history.origins: Stud poker first appeared in America as early as the 1860s; five card stud was the earliest stud form. Five Card Stud High-Low is a split-pot variant: the pot is divided between the best high hand and the best qualifying low hand, with declaration (high or low) after the final betting round in home games.

setup.dealing: Each player receives one card face down (hole card) and one face up, then three more cards face up, one at a time, with a betting round after each round of cards.

rules.objective: Win the high half of the pot with the best high hand and/or the low half with the best qualifying low hand (e.g. 8-or-better). Low must qualify to win.
rules.gameplay: Deal and betting are the same as in ordinary Five Card Stud. At the showdown the pot is split equally between the highest and lowest hands; the odd chip goes to the high hand if the pot cannot be divided exactly by two. In home games players declare high or low (usually not both) after the final betting round; the best high among declarers and the best low among declarers share the pot.

scoring.winCondition: Win high half and or low half. Low must qualify.
